providers.title: The norm equation
providers.scope: A circulant sign matrix with first row h is Hadamard if and only if h h* = n in Z[C_n].
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Even squares
providers.scope: The order of a circulant Hadamard matrix greater than 1 is an even square.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Barker sequences of even length
providers.scope: A Barker sequence of even length n > 2 is the first row of a circulant Hadamard matrix.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Rings generated by roots of unity
providers.scope: They are free abelian of finite rank and Noetherian, with Noetherian localizations, and B/pB is nonzero.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Principal maximal ideals
providers.scope: In a Noetherian local domain with maximal ideal (t), every nonzero element is a unit times a power of t.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The unramified local ring
providers.scope: Localizing Z[eta], eta of order prime to p, at a maximal ideal above p gives a local ring with maximal ideal pA.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Adjoining a p-power root of unity
providers.scope: A[xi] is free with basis 1, ..., xi^(D-1), local with maximal ideal (xi - 1), p = unit (xi-1)^D, and R(xi) is divisible by p^l exactly when all coefficients of R are.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The order restriction (Turyn)
providers.scope: A circulant Hadamard matrix of order n > 1 has n = 4u^2 with u odd.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Character comparison (OpenAI)
providers.scope: If F K = p^e b in A[C_(p^e)] with b a unit, then F(rho)/F(1) and K(rho)/K(1) are units with residue 1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Kronecker's criterion
providers.scope: An element of a ring generated by roots of unity with all images of absolute value 1 is a root of unity; a root of unity with residue 1 in characteristic p has p-power order.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Alternating products (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For x x* = u^2 in Z[i][C_(u^2)], u > 1 odd, the alternating product of character values is a root of unity of odd order.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: First-order terms
providers.scope: For t in the maximal ideal of a local domain, 1 + tL maps to L modulo the maximal ideal as a homomorphism.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The circulant Hadamard conjecture (OpenAI)
providers.scope: A real circulant Hadamard matrix of order n exists if and only if n is 1 or 4.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Even-length Barker sequences
providers.scope: A Barker sequence of even length n exists only for n = 2 and n = 4.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
